deposits.title: SINGLE-LEG POWER

exercises.name: Dopa Band Side-Step Single Leg Drill
exercises.cue: Light resistance; fast clean entry, controlled reset. Stop when speed fades.
exercises.prescription: 3 crisp single-leg entries/side; reset fully between reps. No grind or fatigue circuit.
exercises.home: 3 crisp single-leg entries/side; reset fully between reps. No grind or fatigue circuit.

deposits.effort: Fresh, fast reps. Rest 90 sec after both sides.
deposits.label: A

deposits.title: BELT SQUAT

exercises.name: Belt Squat
exercises.prescription: 3 sets of 6–8. Choose a load leaving 2–3 good reps; record load.
exercises.home: 3 sets of 6–8. Choose a load leaving 2–3 good reps; record load.

deposits.effort: Leave 2–3 good reps in reserve. Rest is included in the timer.

martialSupplement.name: DUMMY LAB · SINGLE-LEG STUDY
martialSupplement.home: Watch one familiar entry; rehearse slowly 3 times/side. Freeze at contact and inspect position.
martialSupplement.away: Visualize the same positions and write one question.
martialSupplement.cue: One question: where do posture or connection change? Pause and inspect.
martialSupplement.text: 7 min slow technical study. Record one discovery. Not conditioning.
